meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑一次视觉核对,用截图确认界面改动是否正常。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完界面都要靠肉眼反复确认有没有走样。
copy.tagline_en: Check any UI change with screenshots and get a clear pass-or-fail verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep eyeballing every UI change to make sure nothing broke.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会对你构建或修改的界面做视觉 QA:先截图留证,再并行派两路只读审阅,最后逐页给出通过或不通过的结论。覆盖网页、终端 TUI 和分页文档。
howto.when: 在你构建或改动任何 UI 之后、宣布完成之前触发;被问某页面、组件或终端界面看起来对不对时也会用。没有渲染界面的纯后端逻辑会跳过。

say.text: 给这个页面做视觉 QA,截图后给结论
say.note: 先截图,再并行派两路审阅

say.text: 这个终端界面在 80 列下会溢出吗
say.note: 跑 tui-check 查溢出和边框

say.text: 这份 PDF 每一页都跟参考图比一下
say.note: 逐页渲染成图做像素对比

howto.what_en: Claude runs visual QA on any UI it builds or changes: it captures screenshots as evidence, dispatches two read-only reviews in parallel, then gives a per-page pass or fail verdict. Covers web, TUI, and paginated documents.
howto.when_en: Fires after you build or change any UI, before calling it done, and when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Skipped when there is no rendered surface.

say_en.text: Run visual QA on this page and give a verdict
Does this TUI overflow at 80 columns?
say_en.note: Runs tui-check for overflow and borders

say_en.text: Compare every page of this PDF to the reference
say_en.note: Renders each page and diffs it
